title: Finite-Tor constructible localizing hull with specified coproduct size
statement: Fix universes $u,w$. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme in universe $u$. In the ordinary unbounded derived category $D_X=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$, let $\mathcal C_X$ be the bounded finite-constant-model constructible objects of finite Tor amplitude from [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Define $\mathcal H_X^{(w)}$ to be the intersection of all full replete triangulated object properties containing $\mathcal C_X$ and closed under all ambient coproducts indexed by types in universe $w$, using exactly the generic $w$-indexed localizing-closure construction of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Thus the indexing universe is explicit and independent of the object universe of $D_X$; no derived-completeness condition is imposed.

source.place: Smallest triangulated subcategory containing Dctf and closed under arbitrary direct sums, with the fixed indexing universe made explicit.
